job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Develop robust, scalable, and high-performance backend applications using Python.
Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using FastAPI and/or Flask.
Participate in High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) for distributed systems, caching, and messaging architectures.
Design and deploy scalable cloud-based solutions on AWS or other cloud platforms.
Implement automated testing using frameworks like PyTest or UnitTest.
Work with both SQL and NoSQL databases, focusing on query optimization and performance.
Manage CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, and cloud-native application deployment.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues.

Requirements & Preferred Skills

Experience: 4 to 12 Years
Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Plus Point: Experience with Data Pipelines, ETL processes, and workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.
Plus Point: Prior domain experience in Healthcare / Payer industry requirements.
